# External labelled datasets (Phase 8)

Raw downloads of the externally sourced datasets go here, one folder per `source_id` from
`outputs/phase8/phase8_dataset_source_inventory.csv`.

**Nothing has been downloaded yet.** Acquisition waits on approval of `outputs/phase8/phase8_integration_plan.md`.

Per source:
- `<SOURCE_ID>/raw/` holds the files exactly as downloaded and is never edited.
- `<SOURCE_ID>/MANIFEST.sha256` is written immediately after download.
- `<SOURCE_ID>/SOURCE.md` records the URL, version, licence, download date and citation.
